description: Codify the absence-assertion oracle idiom (use `! grep -q`, never grep -q + -L/-l) on the planner Oracle Contract and the auditor acceptance-criteria-health check, in both cam-project and embedded template copies.

userStories.title: Add absence/presence oracle idiom to the planner Oracle Contract
userStories.description: As a PRD planner agent, I need the Oracle Contract section to prescribe `! grep -q PATTERN file` for absence assertions and forbid combining grep's quiet flag -q with a list-files flag -L/-l, so I never emit the self-nullifying oracle form that produces a false BLOCK.
acceptanceCriteria: The Oracle Contract section in .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md states: use `! grep -q PATTERN file` for an absence assertion, `grep -q PATTERN file` for a presence assertion, and never combine grep's quiet flag -q with a list-files flag -L or -l (self-nullifying). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'self-nullifying' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md]
The same idiom text is present in templates/agents/subagent-planner.md. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'self-nullifying' templates/agents/subagent-planner.md]
The template edit is re-embedded so the embedded copy carries the idiom text. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
The existing embedded.test.ts planner describe block is extended with a test asserting the embedded planner copy contains the absence-idiom convention text. [oracle: bun test test/embedded.test.ts]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md (Oracle Contract section ~line 113-128), templates/agents/subagent-planner.md (same section), src/vendor/_generated.ts (regenerated by `bun run embed-vendor`, do not hand-edit), test/embedded.test.ts (extend the existing `templatesContents — oracle contract in planner prompt (US-001)` describe block ~line 120). Skill/pattern: 'Agent-prompt self-hosting pattern' — templates/ is source of truth, .claude/ is runtime mirror; edit BOTH copies then run `bun run embed-vendor`, and note it as intentional self-hosting in the commit so the auditor does not flag harness drift. Gotcha: correct absence idiom is `! grep -q` (shell negation, inverts correctly on GNU and BSD/macOS grep); `grep -Lq` does NOT (-q nullifies -L and exits 0 on first match). Do NOT touch scripts/cam/patterns.md (~line 770 already carries the CAM-301 bullet).

userStories.title: Make the auditor BLOCK on the -q + -L/-l oracle antipattern
userStories.description: As a PRD auditor agent, I need the acceptance-criteria-health check to raise a CRITICAL finding / BLOCK when an oracle combines grep's -q with -L or -l (in any order or spacing), and to name the prescribed `! grep -q` replacement, so a self-nullifying oracle is rejected before it reaches an implementer.
acceptanceCriteria: The acceptance-criteria-health check (section C) in .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md instructs a CRITICAL finding / BLOCK when an oracle combines grep's -q with -L or -l in any order or spacing (-Lq, -qL, -L -q, -lq), described as the general class rather than a single literal string, and names the prescribed replacement `! grep -q`. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'grep' .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md]
The same instruction is present in templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md and names `! grep -q` as the replacement. [oracle: file-assert grep -q '! grep -q' templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md]
The template edit is re-embedded so the embedded auditor copy carries the new instruction. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]

The existing embedded.test.ts auditor describe block is extended with a test asserting the embedded auditor copy contains the -q + -L/-l antipattern-BLOCK instruction and the `! grep -q` replacement text. [oracle: bun test test/embedded.test.ts]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
